cause_quote: The new execa-output.ts created the output socket with `const directory = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), "oc-spawn-"));` and `server.listen(path.join(directory, "out"))` with no Unix-socket path length budget or short fallback.
user_saw: Under a long temporary directory, buffered commands run through the Gateway spawn broker failed with EINVAL and private Git history did not reach native child sessions.
summary: Buffered command output sockets now share the native-resource broker's socket-path budget and fall back to a short /tmp directory when the temp-root path would exceed the platform limit.
reasoning: The buffered-output Unix socket was introduced with the spawn broker in 67cedc32 (#150564), whose execa-output.ts placed it under tmpdir() with no length check; later commits only moved the function into execa-worker.ts (#175834) without changing that. The sibling resource-authority socket already had a 103-byte budget, so this path simply never had one.
